strategies.name: overnight_range_break_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the overnight/pre-market high and low, then wait for price to break one side of that range with confirmation: strength for an upside break or weakness for a downside break. strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the broken overnight level: below the prior overnight high for longs, above the prior overnight low for shorts. variants.variant_label: Long continuation after break above overnight high
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Break above with strength, then bullish retest candle/price action with elevated volume
